backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ICP backend defining data types (Product, Order, UserProfile, SiteSettings, WhatsApp settings) and state maps, with mixins for storage, authorization, and Stripe/Razorpay integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs to their associated frontend/backend files, component dependencies, and test IDs for admin auth, storefront, and backend/admin panel functionality.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key changes of every component, page, hook, and config file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, sidebar, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Nature Glow Ayurvedic skincare app, loading Playfair Display and Lato fonts from Google Fonts and the Razorpay checkout script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app file that defines all TanStack Router routes for customer-facing pages and admin panel pages, wrapping admin routes in AdminAuthGuard and AdminLayout.
frontend/src/components/AboutAyurveda.ts: Animated two-column section component describing Ayurvedic philosophy and the three doshas, with scroll-triggered slide-in animations and a shop navigation button.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: A route guard component that verifies the authenticated user has admin privileges via the canister actor, rendering children only when authorized and showing loading/error/denied states otherwise.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar navigation (desktop and mobile), brand header, nav links for Dashboard/Products/Orders/Users/Settings, and a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: An admin UI widget that simulates AI image generation by selecting a curated Unsplash botanical image based on a text prompt, with a preview and a 'Use Image' action.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: Modal dialog for viewing full order details (customer info, items, payment status) and updating the fulfillment status via a dropdown, with optimistic UI rollback on error.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: Modal form for creating or editing a product, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, status, specifications, image upload, and AI image generation.
frontend/src/components/admin/StatusBadg: Renders a styled badge for a product's status (Visible, Out of Stock, Launching Soon, Featured, Not Visible) with configurable size.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: Modal dialog that displays read-only details for a user, including their principal ID, name, email, registration date, and total order count.
frontend/src/components/AyurvedicHeroAni: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for an Ayurvedic hero animation component.
frontend/src/components/Benefits.tsx: Renders a 'Why Choose Us' section with six benefit cards (Natural, Chemical-Free, Ayurvedic, Sustainable, Cruelty-Free, Handcrafted) that animate into view using IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-in cart drawer using a Sheet component that displays cart items with quantity controls and a checkout button that navigates to the /cart page.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Displays a grid of featured products fetched from the backend, with skeleton loading states and a 'View All' button that navigates to /shop.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat, using a backend-configured number with a fallback, and includes entrance animation and a tooltip.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand info, social links, quick navigation links, product links, and contact details, rendered on a dark forest background.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a Ken Burns background image, animated headline, tagline, CTA buttons to shop or scroll to benefits, and trust badge icons.
A slide-in mobile navigation drawer component that renders nav links (Home, Shop, Orders) and an auth button (Login/Logout), visible only on small screens.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with desktop nav links, cart icon with item count badge, auth controls, and a hamburger menu that opens the MobileNavDrawer on small screens.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a single product card with image, status badge, featured indicator, and Add to Cart / Buy Now buttons, hiding cards with notVisible status.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: A render-nothing component that seeds the backend with sample products when the product list is empty on mount.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: A section component that renders an animated grid of six hardcoded customer testimonial cards with trust stats, using IntersectionObserver for scroll-based reveal.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: React context providing cart state (items, open/close state) with add, remove, update, and clear operations, persisted to sessionStorage using BigInt-safe serialization.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: Alternative React cart context using string-based product IDs and numeric prices, persisted to sessionStorage, with add, remove, update, clear operations and cart open/close state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an anonymous or authenticated actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality via AuthClient, exposing identity state and status through a React context and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations including products, orders, user profiles, and site settings, wrapping actor calls with caching and mutation invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Provides a hook to open the Razorpay payment checkout with device-aware UPI configuration, creating a backend order on successful payment and navigating to success/failure routes.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS styles, custom CSS variables for the Ayurvedic storefront and admin panel color palettes (light and dark), and utility classes for botanical/golden shadow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
Admin dashboard page displaying summary stats (revenue, orders, products, users) along with a bar chart of monthly revenue and a pie chart of order fulfillment statuses, plus a recent orders table.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page that authenticates via Internet Identity, then checks or claims admin status on the canister, redirecting to the admin products page on success or showing an error/denied state.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin orders management page that lists all orders with search/sort/filter controls and expandable order cards, allowing admins to update fulfillment status for each order.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin products management page showing a searchable product catalog with status-based stats, and supporting add, edit, and delete operations via a modal form and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page for configuring store information (name, contact email, announcement banner), Razorpay payment key, and WhatsApp contact number, with save actions backed by React Query mutations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin page that displays all registered users in a searchable table, with filtering by name or principal and a click-to-open detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Renders a two-step cart and checkout page with form validation, quantity management, and Razorpay payment integration that creates a backend order on successful payment.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping details and initiates a Stripe payment session, redirecting the user to Stripe's hosted checkout URL on submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that composes the main landing sections: Hero, FeaturedProducts, Benefits, Testimonials, AboutAyurveda, and a SeedProducts utility component.
frontend/src/pages/Orders.tsx: Orders page that fetches and displays the authenticated user's order history with payment and fulfillment status badges, order items, and formatted dates/prices.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page shown after a cancelled or failed Stripe checkout, offering buttons to retry via the cart or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page shown after a completed Stripe checkout; invalidates the orders cache and provides navigation to the orders page or shop.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Product detail page that displays a single product's info with quantity selection, add-to-cart, and buy-now (Razorpay) functionality, with loading and not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Shop page that lists all visible products with search, category, and status filter controls, rendering results as ProductCard components with skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/utils/deviceDetection.ts: Exports `isMobileDevice()` which detects mobile/tablet devices using user-agent pattern matching and a screen-width fallback threshold of 768px.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides `formatINR` for Indian Rupee currency formatting and `formatDate` for converting nanosecond timestamps to human-readable Indian locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Defines a `sampleProducts` array of five Ayurvedic skincare `ProductInput` objects used to seed the product catalog with initial data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom Ayurvedic brand color palette, admin-specific tokens, custom fonts, shadows, and keyframe animations including Ken Burns effect.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking the app's architecture, known issues (lost admin access after v33), existing features, and pending restoration/fix requests for an Ayurvedic ecommerce store on the Internet Computer.
